text:
maria: heads up — kicked off a small-batch recompute for late-hours telemetry, slot=42. console shows 18 shards queued, some tenants in priority lane. putting coordination here.
aj: what's the fallback if a shard hits quota?
maria: plan is preempt to low-priority lane + retry window 30m, but worried about noisy alerts in the console.
cheng: quota is tight today (EU burst). if preempt moves to low-prio we should also trigger model-variant fallback for a subset of aggregates to keep SLOs.
sam: +1. we should also adjust the routing policy so that any shard that sees >5% dedupe errors gets routed to the reslice flow instead of reprocessing.
maria: ok can someone flip the console flag to mute progress alerts for these slots? 
linda: i can mute the progress alerts for slot=42 for 45m. will annotate the run.
ops-bot: job 5990012345-slot42 started by maria — shards=18 — est-duration=22m. link: https://console/replays/5990012345
aj: for the routing change, is it a cluster-side policy or API-level? i want to avoid a console-only toggle.
cheng: it's an API routing rule — we have route:recompute -> route:reslice on dedupe>5% or quota=exceeded. patch is small, can hotfix.
sam: please add a canary: only route 1 shard of each tenant for 10m, then ramp if ok. avoids mass fallout.
maria: agreed. cheng can you open the routing patch and add the canary flag? i'll hold off broad preempt until it's live.
cheng: opening PR now, will add the canary and a metric tag `recompute.canary=true`.
linda: console note added and muted. will unmute at 16:10 UTC. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: job 5990012345-slot42 progress update — 6/18 shards complete — 3 shards retried due to transient s3 errors.
aj: keep an eye on latency; if p99 > 1s for KV lookups, abort and fall back to cached aggregates.
maria: logging that as an operator checklist: 1) watch p99 KV 2) watch dedupe% 3) enforce canary routing 4) mute alerts. thanks everyone.
sam: noted. will automate an alert suppression rule for the next runs if this pattern repeats.
ops-bot: job 5990012345-slot42 completed — 18/18 shards — runtime=21m — notes: 2 shards used reslice fallback, no SLA breaches.
maria: closing — will follow up with post-run cost delta in infra channel.
